standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme case over a Jacobson base
standard_prerequisites.use: Etale morphisms of schemes over a Jacobson base are Jacobson.

standard_prerequisites.name: Jacobson is etale-local
standard_prerequisites.use: Etale-local descent of the Jacobson property.

core_obligations: Take a surjective etale cover U -> X of finite type over the base.
U is a scheme, Jacobson by the scheme case.
The Jacobson property is etale-local on the target; conclude X is Jacobson.
